text:
Power Stations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the testing procedure I1, which must be performed every 6 
months as indicated by M6 in the above title block.
The first draft 
 initiated by eng. Hesham El Sayed Mohamed El Assy, tested by eng. Mohamed Gad 
 El Rab Hawad at 19 Feb 2003, 
 reviewed by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Abdel Momem El-Emam, accepted by general 
 director eng. Farouk Awad Aly, and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam Head Sector of 
 Talkha power plant.
Query provides a 
point and click interface to construct and analyze the execution of the queries 
specifically designed for Industrial SQLTM Server. Query provides an 
efficient and simple method to develop simple and complex queries for your 
reporting and custom application requirements. It also is an 
excellent way to learn the proper syntax for developing SQL queries.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should be carry the Suitable safety category,
Make Backup for soft ware before work.
Tools and Equipment
Original Software
CD Writer to Take Backup
Floppy Disks.
Paper And Pen.
Original Software
CD Writer to Take Backup
Floppy Disks.
Paper And Pen.
Work to be carried out
Start the program select
The program windows appear
Select the server (2INSQL OR 1 INSQL)
From menu file chose the connect command
Select the type of signals (Analog)
Check the signal right or fault
Repeat steps from 2 to 6 with (Discrete)
Repeat steps from 2 to 6 with (string)
Repeat steps from 2 to 6 with (Event)
Repeat steps from 2 to 6 with (History value)
Repeat steps from 2 to 6 with (Live value)
Close the program.
Return the system to Normal 
operation
After That You Can Close This Program And Test 
Operation From Any Signals if like this ---- 
this means the program is ok
